summary: Iteration 21 (frontend-only, public preview, 375x667) tested the REAL back-navigation fix. REGRESSION FOUND (CRITICAL): the auth-gate back arrow IS now a genuine pop (URL /subscription?from=onboarding -> /onboarding, window.history.length unchanged 3->3, no new history entry) BUT it lands on the 'Generating your stories...' screen (onboarding live state screen=24), NOT question 20/20 - and the user is STUCK there (GenBar onDone already fired once and never re-fires; the Generating screen has no back button or CTA). Root cause: persistAndNavigate('/subscription') (onboarding.tsx:723-727) calls setLastOnboardingScreen(23) which only updates the module cache, while the LIVE screen state stays 24 (set by handleFinishQuestions -> goNext). With router.push the onboarding route stays MOUNTED in the stack, so router.back() reveals the preserved instance at screen 24; the module cache only helps on a full remount (which is why iteration_20's replace() version passed). Suggested fix: call setScreen(23) instead of setLastOnboardingScreen(23) before router.push (setScreen updates both live state and module cache). PASS: (1) fresh open starts at splash; (2) welcome -> Log in -> /login -> back (aria-label='Go back') -> welcome; (3) gate back is a true pop, not a push, and does NOT land on paywall or splash; (4) sign-in at gate with delivered@resend.dev via OTP override -> premium isSubscribed effect (dismissAll + replace) -> Home rendered (<2s when reproduced in isolation); (5) browser-back from Home never lands on onboarding or the sign-in gate (stack hygiene works); (6) Reset Journey -> fresh splash with empty name field. NOT exercised live: demo purchase path (Confirm Free Trial -> purchasePlan) because delivered@resend.dev is already premium and the isSubscribed effect redirected first; that code path (SubscriptionContext.tsx:327-329) mirrors the verified effect path. No app console errors.

rca_of_issue: BUG: Back from sign-in gate lands on stuck 'Generating your stories...' screen. Repro: complete onboarding to q20/20, fill partner answer + Yes/No, tap 'Generate My Profile' (live screen state -> 24), wait ~10s for /subscription?from=onboarding email gate, tap back arrow. Observed: URL pops to /onboarding (history.length 3->3, genuine pop) but the visible screen is Generating (screen 24) with a completed/frozen progress bar, no back button, no CTA - dead end. RCA: handleFinishQuestions (onboarding.tsx:954) sets live screen to 24 via goNext; persistAndNavigate (onboarding.tsx:713-732) then only updates the module cache setLastOnboardingScreen(23) before router.push('/subscription'). Because push keeps /onboarding mounted in the expo-router stack, router.back() reveals the preserved instance still at screen 24; GenBar's animation already completed and its onDone (which triggered the push) never fires again. Iteration_20 passed because replace() unmounted onboarding, so back remounted it and read the cached 23. Mitigation/fix: in persistAndNavigate use setScreen(23) (updates live state + module cache) before router.push; optionally add a safety redirect if screen===24 mounts without a pending generation. Verify with the retest steps in action_items.
